evals.name: orders-lazy-init-no-session
evals.prompt: GET /orders fails with the exception in logs/app.log. This is a Spring Boot project (pom.xml, sources under src/). Fix it properly; mvn is not available here, so reason from the files.
evals.expected_output: Pinned Boot 3.3.4 / Hibernate 6 from pom.xml; LazyInitializationException row: JOIN FETCH or @EntityGraph on findByStatus and/or a DTO instead of returning the entity; open-in-view stays false; no FetchType.EAGER, no fail-on-empty-beans.

checks.text: The fix is a fetch join, entity graph, or DTO projection

expectations: Phase 1 done: the Boot line (3.3.4), the Hibernate major and the jakarta namespace were written down from pom.xml before any fix, and the chosen table row is named.

Phase 2 done: the LazyInitializationException row was matched, its fix applied in the listed order (fetch join / entity graph first, DTO projection second), and the reply says how the tell would be verified gone (the endpoint or a test re-run), without open-in-view=true or EAGER.
